name: Hamburg
author: pierreggt
description: Map of Hamburg, Germany, from the city center to Hamburg Airport, spanning the surrounding Schleswig-Holstein satellite towns (Norderstedt, Elmshorn, Pinneberg, Ahrensburg, and others). Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022). Real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchor the smaller satellite towns; Hamburg city itself relies on a POI-density gravity model due to a persistent data-source access issue at build time (see Methodology).
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online) for satellite towns, gravity model for Hamburg city, OSM, Overture Maps
